name: Squeeze, the Full Moon of Raise Moon - JACKPOT!
effectText:
2+ Level 7 monsters
Your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. If this card is Xyz Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the hand (except during the Damage Step): You can detach any number of materials from this card; place that many cards your opponent controls on the bottom of the Deck in any order. You can only use this effect of "Squeeze, the Full Moon of Raise Moon - JACKPOT!" once per turn. Each time an opponent's card(s) is moved out of the Main Deck by an opponent's card, except by drawing it: You can attach the top card of your opponent's Deck to this card.
